about_the_game:
Kreis Aren: Ashes of the Uprising is a dynamic 2.5D action RPG set on the planet Miridia. The Vellarian, a once-peaceful race of inventors, are now on the brink of annihilation after a brutal invasion by the ruthless Traxians. You are Kreis Aren, a brilliant but reluctant inventor who must rise to become the hero his people desperately need. Your journey isn't just a series of epic battles; it's a deep and impactful story where your choices will determine the fate of an entire world.

Engage in fast-paced 2.5D combat, using a powerful arsenal of unique weapons and destructive magical abilities to defeat hordes of enemies and meticulously designed bosses. Every fight is a test of your reflexes and tactical thinking.

Dive into a deep crafting system where you collect resources and discover blueprints to forge unique weapons and armor. Experiment with different materials and modifications to gain an edge in combat and customize your gear to fit your playstyle.

Explore diverse and detailed locations, from ancient ruins and mystical forests to ruined industrial complexes and enigmatic alien structures. Every area is filled with secrets, puzzles, and hidden items waiting to be discovered.

Your decisions in dialogues and at key moments of the game will influence the story's progression and the outcome of the uprising. Will you become the savior of your people or face a different destiny Every choice matters.
